title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-ethan-morales-with-alicia-park-2026-03-04
content:
1:1 prep notes — Ethan Morales (CSM) 
With: Alicia Park (AE) — 2026-03-04
Context: weekly sync to align on renewal health, top upsell motions, and any technical blockers requiring SE/infra help. Keep short, focus on decisions and owners.

Agenda:
- Quick wins / shoutouts (2-3 min)
- Top 3 accounts to review (Acme Retail, NeoHealth, BetaApps) (10-12 min)
- Renewal & pricing motion (5 min)
- Technical blockers / SE asks (5 min)
- Next actions & owners (3 min)

Notes / account snapshots:
1) Acme Retail (Tier: Strategic / ARR: $1.2M)
   - Renewal: 2026-06-15 (formal notice window in May)
   - Current health: yellow — billing dispute (invoice for Dedicated last cycle), one latency incident last month (resolved)
   - Open items: finance needs an itemized invoice and cost breakdown for dedicated vs hosted for FY26 commit.
   - Alicia's ask: want a clean ROI chart for dedicated capacity vs hosted over 12 months (include burst costs).
   - SE ask: offer a quick performance snapshot (<5 slides) showing 95th p95 latency with current config.
   - Jira/linked: CS-3421 (billing dispute), PR for invoice template in /billing repo.
   - Risk level: medium-high — needs action by 2026-05-01.

2) NeoHealth (Tier: Mid-market / ARR: $180k) — pilot -> production
   - Renewal / expansion: pilot ends 2026-04-10; decision meeting proposed 2026-03-25
   - Technical blocker: private deployment networking (VPC peering + SAML) — SE and infra engaged, delay due to customer firewall rules.
   - Action: escalate to infra contact (Jordan Kim) to assist SRE network reachability checks.
   - Linked: OPS-1198 (networking ticket).
   - Goal for 1:1: confirm Alicia will propose a 30-min sync between NeoHealth infra lead and our infra team this week.

3) BetaApps (Tier: Growth / ARR: $60k) — upsell opportunity
   - Use case: spike in embedding calls; currently on hosted API -> asking about Dedicated to reduce unit cost.
   - Ask: run cost model + recommended Dedicated config + projected savings (6/12/24 month).
   - Opportunity: propose a pilot reserved pool (3 months) with commit discount to prove savings.
   - Follow-up: Ethan to draft pilot terms and share with Alicia by 2026-03-09.

Broader pipeline notes:
- Keep list of customers with pilots ending in Q2 (NeoHealth, OmniSys). Need to prioritize outreach two weeks before pilot end.
- Check with Product about any upcoming model changes that might impact latency/cost for customers on Dedicated in April (Alicia to loop in product PM: Priya Singh).

Questions for Alicia:
- Any new churn signals from accounts on monthly billing? (Which ones?)
- Which AEs are aligned on cross-sell plays for existing Dedicated customers?
- Can Alicia lead the commercial ask for Acme (finance intro)?

Action items (owner / due):
- Ethan: build Acme ROI chart + 1-slide perf snapshot request to SE (due 2026-03-12) [owner: Ethan, SE: Maya]
- Alicia: intro to Acme finance + confirm meeting week of 2026-03-22 (due 2026-03-08)
- Ethan: draft BetaApps pilot terms and share with Alicia (due 2026-03-09)
- Alicia: schedule NeoHealth infra sync with Jordan Kim & our infra team (due 2026-03-06)
- Jordan Kim (infra): triage OPS-1198 and provide checklist for NeoHealth networking (due 2026-03-05)

Follow-up / notes to self:
- Remind SE to keep perf snapshot light: p50/p95/p99 for default load + small note about token mix.
- Update Confluence playbook (linked) with the Acme billing example once resolved (owner: Ethan).
- Add specific renewal dates to CRM and set two reminder tasks: 60 days and 30 days prior.

Loose thoughts / brainstorms (notes to self):
- Could offer a short "Dedicated quick win" onboarding package (3-week) for customers moving from hosted -> dedicated to reduce friction; include 1 hr SE + 1 hr infra review + billing template. Price as a one-time service credit.
- Consider a templated ROI workbook in docs to speed up conversations (Alicia likes spreadsheets).

Links & refs:
- Account playbook (confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/12345-Account+Playbook
- Billing dispute ticket: CS-3421
- Networking ops ticket: OPS-1198
- Internal PR for invoice template: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345
- Slack thread re: Acme invoice: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C03ABCD123/p1677623456789

Ready to run through this in the 1:1 - focus on decisions: finance intro for Acme, NeoHealth infra sync, and BetaApps pilot terms.

End of notes.
